mapper.sql: b.id, b.bill_month AS billMonth, b.wms_tenant_id AS wmsTenantId, t.tenant_name AS wmsTenantName, b.rack_fee AS rackFee, b.inbound_fee AS inboundFee, b.outbound_fee AS outboundFee, b.delivery_fee AS deliveryFee, b.return_fee AS returnFee, b.inspection_fee AS inspectionFee, b.driver_fee AS driverFee, b.total_amount AS totalAmount, b.status, DATE_FORMAT(b.confirmed_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS confirmedTime, DATE_FORMAT(b.paid_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS paidTime, b.remark
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM wms_monthly_bill b LEFT JOIN sys_tenant t ON t.id = b.wms_tenant_id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.deleted = 0
SELECT fee_type AS feeType, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM wms_billing_record WHERE wms_tenant_id = #{wmsTenantId} AND bill_month = #{billMonth} GROUP BY fee_type
SELECT id FROM sys_tenant WHERE tenant_type = 'WMS_OPERATOR' AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1 ORDER BY id
